# One Dark Pro reference

`reference.json` is a color subset extracted from the default `themes/OneDark-Pro.json` in the
official `zhuangtongfa.material-theme` VS Code extension, version **3.20.6**. Its source SHA-256 is
recorded in the JSON. The selection is limited to the editor, UI, ANSI colors and syntax scopes
that FiveLeaf maps directly; it is not a replacement theme file.

Upstream: <https://github.com/Binaryify/OneDark-Pro>

The original MIT license is included in `LICENSE.txt`.
